class.name: SimulationDomain
class.brief_description: An isolated container representing a physics space, scenario, and canvas.
class.description:
[admonition type="note" collapsible="true" open="false"] [b]Part of [i]Godot Engine: Conservatory Edition[/i].[/b] This is not available in the official build of Godot. [/admonition]
An isolated container representing both a 2D and 3D physics space, a render scenario, and a canvas. This is different than a [SubViewport] in that it cannot be rendered to a target; instead, it is intended to be representative of a loaded game world with its own isolated rendering and physics. One instance of a [SimulationDomain] can be made active at a time, and when active, it overrides the root viewport's display.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Instantiates the internal worlds that this domain oversees. This must be called before it can be used.

method.name: make_active
method.description: Only usable on the game client. This will fail if used on the server, or if used on a domain that is already active. It must be in the scene tree. This causes the current [SimulationDomain] to override the root viewport's display. Attempting to reference the world (either 2D or 3D) of the root viewport will return the domain's worlds instead.

method.name: deactivate
method.description: Only usable on the game client. This will fail if used on the server, or used on a domain that is not active. It is called when the domain is removed from the tree. This causes the current [SimulationDomain], if it is the active domain, to restore the original worlds of the root viewport (unless they have been modified).

method.name: set_is_client_ptr
method.description: [b]Only usable by The Conservatory, for internal use only[/b]. Illegal usage will crash the engine.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], this instance is the current one being rendered to the game client's screen. Usage of this method is invalid on servers; there is no screen to render to and so it is always [code]false[/code].
The [RID] of the physics space used for 2D physics in this [SimulationDomain].
The [RID] of the physics space used for 3D physics in this [SimulationDomain].
The [RID] of the canvas used for 2D rendering in this [SimulationDomain]. Not likely to be used in [i]The Conservatory[/i], but here for completeness.
The [RID] of the scenario used for 3D rendering in this [SimulationDomain].
